dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, what time do you wake up?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈwʌt ˈtaɪm duː juː ˈweɪk ˈʌp?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: At a quarter to six. But I get up at six.
dialogue.reading: ət ə ˈkwɔːrtər tə ˈsɪks. bʌt aɪ ˈɡɛt ˈʌp ət ˈsɪks.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I brush my teeth and wash my face.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈbrʌʃ maɪ ˈtiːθ ənd ˈwɑːʃ maɪ ˈfeɪs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And then you take a shower?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈðɛn juː ˈteɪk ə ˈʃaʊər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. Then I get dressed and have breakfast.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ˈðɛn aɪ ˈɡɛt ˈdrɛst ənd ˈhæv ˈbrɛkfəst.
